brief:
Israel is preparing to grant settlers access to a major Palestinian thoroughfare in Ramallah, according to Mondoweiss. The move would introduce checkpoints and gates to one of the West Bank's remaining spaces of unrestricted Palestinian movement and affordable urban development.

The planned access would fundamentally alter conditions on a critical artery for the city, constraining movement and reshaping Ramallah's urban landscape as Israeli settlement expansion continues across the occupied West Bank.
dek: Israel is preparing to give settlers access to a main Palestinian thoroughfare in Ramallah, a move that would bring checkpoints and gates to one of the West Bank’s last spaces of free Palestinian movement and affordable urban growth.
title: Israel plans settler access to Ramallah's main road
